verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a built-in agent that users can delegate work to. It builds segments from plain-text descriptions via "Describe segment", analyzes the workspace, runs recurring scheduled tasks such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps ("Daily Routines"), and takes work from Slack threads. The MCP/CLI evidence covers external AI clients, not the built-in assistant, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product agent, and detailed first-party docs on the agent's full task scope and in-app interface beyond short llms.txt snippets.
